heading: What We Do
paragraphs: Freedom Note Capital owns residential mortgage notes secured by real estate.  Our portfolio primarily consists of performing loans with established borrower payment histories and underlying property collateral.

We hold mortgage notes as long-term income-producing assets. Each acquisition is evaluated individually, including the loan documentation, payment history, lien position, property value, and other factors that may affect risk and long-term performance.

Once acquired, our loans are professionally serviced by third-party loan servicers that handle payment collection, account administration, borrower communication, and other servicing responsibilities.
